preconditions.description: The number of workers is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
The parameter k is a rational number with numerator a and denominator b, where a and b are both between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The string s represents the job categories of the workers and has a length equal to the number of workers n.

postconditions.expression: output is a JSON object with keys 'c' and 'categories'
postconditions.description: The output must be a JSON object containing the number of obtainable job categories 'c' and a list of obtainable job categories 'categories' sorted in lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(category in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for category in categories)
postconditions.description: All job categories in the output are lowercase English letters that are not in the input string s.

postconditions.expression: all(category in obtainable_categories for category in categories)
postconditions.description: All obtainable job categories in the output are also in the set of all possible job categories that can be obtained.

invariants.expression: all(category not in s for category in categories)
invariants.description: None of the obtainable job categories are present in the input string s.
